[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] amassed a '''spy network''' within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] of [[24 BBY/Legends|24]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He was aided in its creation by Master [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]].

His agents were unable to predict the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]; however, in the [[Mission to The Wheel]], they were able to get information on the impending [[First Battle of Kamino|attack on Kamino]].
